description: One status check for a registration, by its content hash: pending (not yet sequenced; retry after the given seconds), awaiting_seal (sequenced, entry id known, receipt not yet sealed — sealing takes minutes, and never happens until delegate_sealing has run for the log), or sealed (the receipt is saved and its path returned). Any other answer from canopy is reported as a problem with its reason. canopy answers a statement it never received exactly like a pending one, so after ten minutes of pending this says so. Does not sleep; pace the retries yourself.

contentHash.description: the content hash register_statement returned (64 lowercase hex)

name: check_registration
title: Check a registration
